post.caption: Spessartine is named for a woodpecker forest. The Spessart is a wooded mountain region in Bavaria, Germany. The name goes back to an old German name meaning woodpecker forest. It is one of the largest unbroken forest areas in Germany. It got its name in the 1800s from where it was found. Its orange color comes from manganese. Spessartine is the orange member of the garnet family. In the early 1990s, vivid orange stones turned up in Namibia. Mandarin garnet is named after the orange fruit, not a place. By the end of the 1990s, Nigeria supplied orange stones too.
